findings.evidence: `rg "baseChange_toCommGrp"` finds uses only in the new `Hom/BaseChange.lean`; no roadmap consumer refers to this equality.
findings.fix: Move this equality to `Hom/BaseChange.lean` as a private helper (or construct `Hom.baseChange` through the public group-operation lemmas) and remove it from the public object API.
findings.issue: `baseChange_toCommGrp` publicly exposes a bundled implementation equality used only to construct and prove properties of `Hom.baseChange`.

findings.evidence: `Hom/Basic.lean` provides both `toOverHom_mk'` (line 91) and `toSchemeHom_mk'` (line 128), while `rg "toSchemeHom_baseChange" code/TauCeti` has no hit.
findings.fix: Add a `[simp]` lemma identifying `Hom.toSchemeHom (Hom.baseChange f L)` with the left component of the pulled-back `Over` morphism.
findings.issue: Base change characterizes `Hom.toOverHom` but omits the parallel `Hom.toSchemeHom_baseChange`, forcing scheme-level consumers to manually project an `Over` equality.

summary: The base-change surface exposes an implementation equality while omitting the scheme-level projection lemma expected by the existing homomorphism API.
